caveats: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive
name: hotosm_cmr_points_of_interest
notes:
Points of interest: public-facing amenities, shops, tourist attractions, and landmarks tagged via `amenity`, `shop`, `tourism`, or `man_made`. Useful for general POI reference, urban analysis, and basemap detail.

Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge.

- Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map
- Tags: [amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [shop](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:shop), [tourism](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism), [man_made](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:man_made)
- Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)

organization.name: hot
organization.title: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
organization.description:
**For up-to-the-minute exports from OpenStreetMap in a variety of formats for GPS and GIS, visit http://export.hotosm.org**

Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) acts as a bridge between the traditional humanitarian responders and the OpenStreetMap Community. HOT works both remotely and physically in countries to assist the collection of geographic data, usage of that information and training others in OpenStreetMap.
